name: soft-purple-winter-girl-portrait
image_vibe: Serene soft winter styling against a lavender gradient with gentle editorial beauty lighting
image_purpose: Create a polished beauty and winter-fashion portrait for lookbook use.

prompt.project_info: A close-up studio portrait of an original adult woman in soft white winter clothing against a seamless pastel purple gradient.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with dark brown-black straight hair, natural fair-to-peach skin, soft pink blush, glossy pink lips, and a calm direct gaze. She wears a fluffy white beret with a small abstract embroidered emblem and a cream ribbed knit sweater, with one index finger resting lightly near the lower lip.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level close-up, face centered as the focal point, head tilted slightly down and to one side, hair framing the face, raised hand and finger gesture visible, soft white beret and sweater against a seamless lavender-to-pink gradient backdrop.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cool soft diffused studio light from the front and slightly above-left, gentle facial modeling, visible catchlights, low contrast, serene pastel winter mood, smooth background falloff.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic beauty editorial, close-up framing, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture and subtle pores, detailed faux-fur and knit fibers, natural fingernails, high-resolution clarity, no readable branding, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic eye-level close-up studio portrait of an original adult woman with dark brown-black straight hair, soft natural skin texture, peach-pink undertones, soft pink blush, glossy pink lips, and a calm direct gaze. Dress her in a fluffy white beret with a small abstract non-readable embroidered emblem and a cream ribbed knit sweater. Let one index finger rest lightly near the lower lip while the head tilts subtly downward. Use a seamless pastel lavender-to-pink gradient background, cool soft diffused light from the front and slightly above-left, gentle catchlights, low contrast, shallow depth of field, detailed fur and knit fibers, high-resolution beauty editorial realism, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized pose, distorted hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, over-smoothed face, malformed beret, readable logo, text, watermark, harsh shadows

assets.name: source soft-purple winter portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for the lavender gradient, white beret, knit styling, soft makeup, and close-up framing; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the soft winter styling, pastel lavender backdrop, white beret, cream knit sweater, finger-near-lip gesture, and serene beauty mood. Use an original adult subject and a non-readable abstract emblem.

changes: Reframed the young-woman wording as an original adult subject.
Converted the potentially identifiable emblem into a non-readable abstract detail.
